mapper.insert: insert into med_exam_appointment (appointment_no, order_id, appointment_date, patient_name, gender, id_card_no, birth_date, phone, address, company, status, create_time) values (#{appointmentNo}, #{orderId}, #{appointmentDate}, #{patientName}, #{gender}, #{idCardNo}, #{birthDate}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{company}, 1, now())
mapper.update: update med_exam_appointment set `status` = 2, checkin_time = now() where appointment_date = current_date and `status` = 1 and id_card_no = #{idCardNo}
mapper.select: select patient_name as patientName, gender, phone, appointment_date as appointmentDate, status, timestampdiff(YEAR, birth_date, now()) as age from med_exam_appointment where order_id = #{orderId}

select a.appointment_no as appointmentNo, o.snapshot_id as snapshotId from med_exam_appointment a join trade_order o on a.order_id = o.order_id where a.appointment_date = current_date and a.id_card_no = #{idCardNo}

select a.appointment_no as appointmentNo, a.order_id as orderId, o.snapshot_id as snapshotId, a.patient_name as patientName, a.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, a.birth_date, now()) as age, a.id_card_no as idCardNo, a.phone, a.appointment_date as appointmentDate, a.company from med_exam_appointment a join trade_order o on a.order_id = o.order_id where a.id = #{id} limit 1
select id from med_exam_appointment where appointment_no = #{appointmentNo} limit 1

select a.patient_name as patientName, a.gender, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, a.birth_date, NOW()) as age, a.phone, a.appointment_no as appointmentNo, a.appointment_date as appointmentDate, a.`status` from med_exam_appointment a where a.appointment_no = #{appointmentNo} limit 1

select a.appointment_no as uuid, a.patient_name as name, a.gender as sex, a.phone as tel, a.birth_date as birthday, timestampdiff(year, a.birth_date, now()) as age, ifnull(a.company, "个人体检") as company, a.appointment_date as `date`, o.goods_title as goods from med_exam_appointment a join trade_order o on a.order_id = o.order_id where a.id = #{id} limit 1
